chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Husayn al-Qalanisi, who said:
I wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Mazi (peace be upon him) asking him about al-fuqqa' (fermented drink), so he said: 'Do not go near it, for it is from the wine.'

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الْمَاضِي: Abu al-Hasan al-Mazi (the seventh Imam, Ali al-Naqi, peace be upon him), referring to the Imam at the time of the narration.
key_terms.الْخَمْر: Wine, the primary category of intoxicants in Islamic law, used here as a classification for other fermented drinks.
key_terms.الْفُقَّاع: Fermented drink, specifically referring to a type of beer or ale made from grains, often distinguished from grape wine but still classified under wine rulings.
key_terms.لَا تَقْرَبْهُ: Do not go near it, a common juristic phrase indicating prohibition or strong discouragement to avoid doubt.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on fermented drinks (fuqqa') in Shia jurisprudence according to the Imams?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Husayn al-Qalanisi inquires of Imam al-Mazi (AS) regarding 'al-fuqqa'', a specific fermented beverage, to which the Imam responds with a direct prohibition by classifying it as 'khamr' (wine). This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle that any drink causing intoxication, regardless of its specific name or preparation method, falls under the general prohibition of wine. The Imam’s concise answer underscores the importance of avoiding all intoxicants to preserve spiritual and physical purity.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Husayn Al Qalanasy who said,

‘I wrote to Abu Al-Hassan Al-Maazy<sup>asws</sup> (7th Imam<sup>asws</sup>) asking him<sup>asws</sup> about the fermented drink, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not go near it for it is from the wine (classification)’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Husayn al-Qalanisiy who has said the following:
“Once I asked abu al-Hassan, al-Madiy, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, in writing and asked about al-Fuqa ’ (beer). He (the Imam) wrote to me saying, ‘Do not go close to it; it is wine.’”
